searchText: Including data for reconstructing the state? Seems to contradict <@238630472522006528> 's comment above (assuming zksync is within "the 3 other instances") As I understand it it does, yes zkSync is not StarkEx. The "3 other instances" of StarkEx are DeversiFi, Immutable X and Sorare > I'm 99% sure they don't do it. What is this referring to? Ok! So they have techniques to reduce that... I guess they can do a zk-proof of state change. Probably has to be per-batch otherwise you wouldn't gain much compared to just posting the transaction (size-wise)? If anybody knows of a writeup that does a deep dive into zksync/starkex details, I'd be super interested. I've read such for Optimism & Arbitrum but have yet to come accross one for the zk-rollups. > I guess they can do a zk-proof that's literally how zk-rollups work, yes vitalik did a writeup a few months ago on his website https://vitalik.ca/general/2021/01/05/rollup.html fairly thorough despite the title lol Yes, put like that 😂 To clarify, I thought they only proved a Merkle root & some extra metadata & not every single state change. But it makes sense! I've read that a while back (should have reread!), I was thinking more of something like https://research.paradigm.xyz/optimism but for starkware/zksync my understanding is that by proving that the post-batch merkle root is correct you're *in the process* proving that all the state changes are correct but you can omit all that because the toplevel proof is enough
